subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Chase rainbows
solution:
The correct answer is **to pursue unrealistic goals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chase rainbows:** trying to do or achieve something that is not really possible or realistic. 

 
 
• **Example: *** I know she wants to become an actor but I think she should stop **chasing rainbows** and get an office job.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is given in **option 3**.
